title: Coefficient modes compare the commutator with the genuine smooth Yoneda dg algebra
statement: At tau=-3/2, the weight-zero coupled BRST Lie algebra maps quasi-isomorphically to the commutator dg Lie algebra of the graded opposite of the ordinary smooth vacuum derived endomorphisms, via its actual (-1)-modes on every coefficient.
scope: All smooth weak modules; signed opposite via pro-precomposition. The normal product on states is used only through its Lie commutator.

title: The native translation image is an acyclic Lie ideal
statement: The complete weight-zero bracket lands in T K(V)_{-1}. The native BRST negative-weight cohomology vanishes and translation is injective by the highest differential PBW jet, so the quotient Lie algebra is abelian and quasi-isomorphic to the original.
scope: Internal-weight minus-one source and zero-weight recipient on the noncritical specialized polynomial three-ghost complex.

title: The native quartic is zero and each exceptional vacuum endomorphism algebra is associatively formal
statement: On three copies of the marked a and one of u, symmetrization gives 6 gamma az. The genuine commutator algebra is homotopy abelian and az is nonzero, hence gamma=0. The previously verified marked normal form then gives ordinary strictly unital associative formality at -3/2 and via the enhanced comparisons at all four exceptional fibres.
scope: Universal principal W4 vacuum, all smooth weak modules. The independent local coefficient-level equivariant nullhomotopy and independently marked reciprocal DS comparison remain separate.

title: Every exceptional vacuum class has a two-sided characteristic lift
statement: The Hochschild characteristic map of the actual derived vacuum endomorphism algebra is surjective on all twelve dimensions because the actual gamma is zero. In particular a and u lift.
scope: The existence of these lifts is obtained by transport from the formal algebra. Raw one-sided Yoneda coefficient modes are not asserted to be strict central bimodule cochains.
